paragraphs.text: Native desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness: approval, question, completion, error and sign-in
banners attributed to the DSH app, with a selectable and customisable synthesised chime.
# dsh-native-notifications

**Native desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)** —
the app itself shows a banner when DSH

needs you (approval, question, sign-in) or finishes work, with a
**chime you can choose or compose*
*. Clicking the banner focuses DSH and opens the conversation.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Unlike helper-process notifications, these banners are **produced by the DSH page itself**, so the
o
perating system attributes them to **DeepSeek Harness** (name and icon) instead of a script runner,

and
clicking one lands back in the app.
## What it notifies
| Harness event | Banner | Default |

| `agent/status` → idle after a turn (root session) | 任务完成 · 用时 … | on |
| `approval/request` still

pending after `approvalDelayMs` | 需要你确认权限 · tool · reason | on |
| `user-questions/request` still pe

nding | 正在等待你的选择 · question | on |
| `agent/error` | 执行出错 · message | on |
| `deepseek-account/model

-sign-in-required` / `session-expired` | 需要登录 / 登录已过期 | on |
| `subagent/end`, `workflow/end` | chil
d agent / workflow finished | off |
Noise guards that matter in practice:
- An approval the Harness settles automatically (for example the Auto permission preset's LLM review

er)
**never rings** — the banner is delayed and only fires while the request still waits for you.
-
After an error banner, that turn's completion banner is suppressed, so one failure does not ring twi

ce.
- Goal rounds and follow-up turns re-enter `running` quickly; completion only fires after the se

ssion stays
idle for `idleGraceMs`.
- Teammates, subagents and workflow children are filtered by `on

lyRootSessions`, so a long multi-agent run
rings once — when the root session is actually done.
## Sound: choose it or compose it
The chime is **synthesised by the plugin with Web Audio** — no audio file, no operating-system defau

lt
sound, and no double ring (the OS sound is suppressed). Every preset reuses the same motifs, so m

eaning
stays recognisable: completion is a rising do-mi-so, "needs you" is a double high boop, error
stays recognisable: completion is a rising do-mi-so, "needs you" is a double high boop, errors fall.
Open **Settings → General → Notification sound**:
| preset | timbre |

| **Playful bubbles** (default) | triangle body with a small upward glide and a high twinkle |
| Sof

t bell | sine body with a quiet octave overtone |
| Bright pluck | short triangle pluck without the

glide |
| Custom | your own note sequence, played with the playful timbre |
| Muted | no chime |
The row has a **Preview** button and, for custom, a text field that accepts up to eight space/comma
separated notes — note names (`C6 E6 G#6`, `Bb5`) or raw frequencies (`1046.5 1318.5`):
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The preference lives in the page's `localStorage` (`dsh-native-notifications:sound`), so it is per
d
evice/browser profile and applies to the next banner without a Host round trip.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then confirm the `desktop-notifications` row is enabled in **Settings → Plugins** (the bundle patch

inserts
it enabled). No build step, no dependencies, no native module: plain ESM for the Host half a

nd a plain-JS
bundle for the Client half.
Requirements:

- a DSH profile that serves the Web UI (the `desktop` or `web` profile);
- the page loads the Client

half automatically on install (the Host graph recompose is synced to the
connected page); if banner

s never appear after a manual copy, reload the window once;
- desktop notifications allowed for **De

epSeek Harness** in the OS settings (macOS: System Settings →
Notifications). Electron grants the pa
ge permission; the OS allowance is separate.
## How it works
One bundle, two halves:

- **Host** (`index.js`) watches the events above and keeps a small ring buffer of banner
events. It

serves two same-origin routes on `ctx.webServer` — `/native-notifications/events` (long poll)
and `/

native-notifications/report` (client diagnostics) — gated by `ctx.connection.requestRejection`
exact

ly like other Host-owned Web routes, so only the authenticated page can read them.
- **Client** (`cl

ient.js`, renderless and always mounted) long-polls those routes, shows each
event through the platf

orm notification API (`new Notification(...)`), and on click focuses DSH and calls
`uiWorkspace.open

Session(sessionId)`. The cursor plus the Host epoch live in `localStorage`, so a reload
never replay
s old banners and a Host restart starts from "now".
The long poll aborts after `wait + 10s` and retries, so a Host remount during a pending request cann

ot
wedge the client. No session events are appended and no Harness Client package is imported; the p

lugin
contributes one bundle row and one Settings row.
## Compatibility

- **Tested on dsh 0.2.1-rc.5 and 0.2.2-rc.1.** The runtime compatibility gate reads the
**top-level*

* `engines.dsh` field (`>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0`); dsh 0.2.2 ignores a
`dsh.engines` declaration, which

is why 1.1.0 moved it.
- Bundle patch + `dsh.client` web half; macOS, Windows and Linux, as long as

the DSH page can
show platform notifications.
- Node 20+ is only needed for repository tooling; the
Host supplies the runtime.

Verified against 0.2.2-rc.1 in a clean profile: the Host half mounts, both authenticated
routes regi

ster, the Client half boots, the settings row renders, and the optional
subagent banner uses the par
ent conversation title from the new `subagent/end` payload.

横幅（归属 DeepSeek Harness，点一下回到 DSH 并打开会话）。提示音

是插件自己合成的，可在

安装：`dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-native-notifications`，然后在插件页确认
`desktop-notifications` 行已启用
